title: Workshop: build a pricing card
summary: Colour a card step by step, using a different notation each time: hex, rgb() with alpha, hsl(), names and transparent.
intro: a pricing card with a badge, a price, a feature list and two buttons. The HTML is already written (see the html tab). Each step adds one or two colours, and the notation changes as you go: hex, `rgb()` with alpha, `hsl()`, a named colour and `transparent`.
